name: Sanzo
role: Wandering musician and storyteller, the Paper Lantern
designNotes:
Created 2026-09-29, extracted from his full cast entry in canon/scenes/rest--the-paper-lantern.json -- the Paper Lantern haunt's Petr-equivalent role (the room's friend). Nothing here is invented beyond what's already written into his `brief` there.

ANCESTRY, Ingram's own pick (2026-09-29): Goblin, checked against data/campaign/ancestry-catalogue.json ('eccentric... tricksters... can live anywhere, eat anything, thrive despite whatever obstacles', terrestrial: true) -- a strong fit for an itinerant who's outlived several other lives. His portrait was deliberately anchored humanoid in the Midjourney prompt ('elderly humanoid goblin man, small wiry build, human proportions and hands') to avoid a monster-not-person render, since Goblin is tagged `humanoid` in the SF2e traits list -- contrast with Tama below, whose ancestry is not.

Why he never leaves is an intentional, unresolved plant, same device as founders.alive in the Crew Mess haunt (see canon/scenes/rest--crew-mess.json's 'the-one-who-paid-for-everyone' event) but its own separate thread, not a restatement of that one -- no fact ref, no coercible mechanism, nothing to reveal yet. Held for later.

His real statblock is still a placeholder in the scene file: "Proposed: level 1, an elderly civilian, non-combat. Made with Ingram once the NPC generator exists."
status: established and voiced (the Paper Lantern haunt is built and playable) -- second regular of the new haunt formalized into a real npc file
